text:
isabel: Quick company announcement: GovCloud & Cross-Account Audit Export API for Private deployments are entering limited GA next week. This enables customers in regulated regions to host Private instances in GovCloud regions and export audit ledgers to a separate account/sink. Docs: https://internal.redwood.io/docs/private/govcloud-export
ops-bot: Notice: GovCloud artifacts pushed by isabel 1781604321
noah: Nice. Important Q  can we support cross-account delivery to customer-managed S3 buckets with server-side-encryption?
isabel: Yes  delivery options: 1) push to customer S3 with SSE-KMS (customer key), 2) push to an intermediate account we manage with enforced HSM-wrapped keys, 3) webhook + signed envelope. See delivery-options section.
kevin: Security note: cross-account S3 requires role assumption + least-privileged policy. We added a sample IAM policy and sts-assume flow in the onboarding doc. Also added a signed-delivery proof (hash + timestamp) in the ledger entries.
anya: Sales ask: do we have a short blurb for compliance teams? they want to know proof-of-delivery semantics and retention guarantees.
isabel: Short blurb for sales: "Redwood GovCloud supports customer-controlled audit export with cryptographic proof-of-delivery and configurable retention. Default retention: 1 year; exportable on-demand." I'll drop a one-pager in sales-assets.
security-bot: Policy update: GOVCLOUD_AUDIT_EXPORT = enabled for select accounts. Enforcement date: 2026-04-15.
noah: Ops question: any extra network requirements for GovCloud installs? outbound egress to our export endpoints might be restricted in some setups. We documented a local relay pattern.
isabel: Relay pattern example added. Small snippet: `audit-relay --listen 127.0.0.1:6515 --forward https://export.redwood-govcloud.internal`
kevin: Also added a signed manifest format for delivered archives. Example header: `{\"ledger_hash\":\"sha256:...\",\"delivered_to\":\"s3://acct-bucket/path\",\"ts\":\"2026-03-18T02:05:00Z\"}`
product-bot: Docs CI: govcloud-export-guide lint passed 1 6 checks.
noah: Pilot rollout plan: we will enable for three pilot customers next Tue. Ops to run dry-run and verify proofs. Volunteers for installs?
anya: I can take pilot #1 and help with customer-facing compliance deck.
kevin: I'll handle IAM templates and the proof verification script. Small example to verify: `python verify_proof.py --archive delivered.tar.gz --manifest manifest.json`
isabel: Action items: 1) Security to finalize IAM & proof format (kevin), 2) Ops to run relay dry-run (noah), 3) Sales to prep one-pager for customers (anya). I'll post pilot schedule and invite pilot customers. Please flag blockers here. :lock::rocket:
